blurb: Bobby Jones Golf Club offers golf lessons through the Grand Slam Golf Academy, equipped with advanced technology and PGA/LPGA instructors. They provide rental options including push carts, tempo walks, riding golf carts, and rental club sets. The club hosts events such as The Buckhead Open, a two-day gross stroke-play golf tournament.
extraNote: All lesson series expire one year from the date of purchase · Gift cards can be used to pay for lessons in person at time of lesson · For Buckhead Open event, full refund if withdrawing on or before May 1st; $95 cancellation fee after May 1st; full charge if withdrawing within 24 hours
